title: Recipe 43 — Wallet-gated action (sign-and-broadcast behind three gates)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Moving real money is the hardest thing to let an agent do. Watch how many gates it has to pass.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the credentials
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — a signer key and an RPC endpoint on top of the model credential.

beats.label: Type the USDC payout spec
beats.cue: “A workflow, not a chat loop — because the steps that move money must be ordered and reviewable.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Lint runs the §47 chain well-formedness pass the compile path skips — the one that catches a malformed gate.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Every gate is a node. Nothing about this is implicit.”

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “Read the gate chain top to bottom — that's the order they fire in.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts, installs, boots: GREEN, gated exactly at the signer credential the spec declares.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the declared credentials gate

groups.title: Beat 3 · what a failed gate looks like

beats.label: Boot with no signer
beats.cue: “Fail-closed: no key, no broadcast, and it says which gate stopped it rather than retrying.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/agent.ts > live/gate.log 2>&1

verify.note: refuses at the first missing gate; nothing is signed and nothing is sent

beats.label: Read the refusal
beats.cue: “A named gate, not a stack trace. That distinction is the whole recipe.”

groups.title: One more thing · run it against a testnet

beats.label: Boot the workflow
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Point it at a testnet RPC first. Always a testnet first.”

verify.note: needs a signer key and an RPC endpoint; broadcasts a real transaction on whatever chain it is pointed at

beats.label: Read how the layers compose
beats.cue: “Permissions, then the justification gate, then the egress check — each one can only narrow, never widen.”
